tasks.label: Build on Save (Debug)
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $root = '${workspaceFolder}'; $cmake = '${config:cmake.cmakePath}'; function Should-Build([string]$path) { if (-not $path) { return $false }; $lower = $path.ToLowerInvariant(); if ($lower.StartsWith(($root + '\build').ToLowerInvariant())) { return $false }; if ($lower.EndsWith('.c') -or $lower.EndsWith('.h') -or $lower.EndsWith('.cpp') -or $lower.EndsWith('.hpp')) { return $true }; return $false }; function Build-Debug() { Write-Host '[build-on-save] build Debug'; & $cmake --build --preset Debug; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Host '[build-on-save] build failed' } else { Write-Host '[build-on-save] build ok' } }; $watcher = New-Object System.IO.FileSystemWatcher $root, '*'; $watcher.IncludeSubdirectories = $true; $watcher.NotifyFilter = [System.IO.NotifyFilters]'LastWrite, Size'; $watcher.EnableRaisingEvents = $true; $null = Register-ObjectEvent -InputObject $watcher -EventName Changed -SourceIdentifier bos_changed; Write-Host '[build-on-save] watcher started'; try { while ($true) { $evt = Wait-Event -SourceIdentifier bos_changed; $fullPath = $null; if ($evt.SourceEventArgs -and $evt.SourceEventArgs.FullPath) { $fullPath = $evt.SourceEventArgs.FullPath }; Remove-Event -EventIdentifier $evt.EventIdentifier; if (Should-Build $fullPath) { Build-Debug } } } finally { Write-Host '[build-on-save] watcher stopped'; Unregister-Event -SourceIdentifier bos_changed -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($watcher) { $watcher.Dispose() } }
